question: What Is a Continuous Emission Monitoring System (CEMS)?
body_html:
A continuous emission monitoring system (CEMS) measures flue gas pollutants such as SO2, NOx, CO, CO2, O2 and particulate matter in real time, giving regulators validated compliance data.

ComponentFunction
Probe and heated lineExtracts the stack sample without condensation
Conditioning unitRemoves moisture with a chiller or dryer
Gas analyzersNDIR, chemiluminescence and O2 sensors measure concentrations
Stack flow monitorMeasures gas velocity for mass emission rate
DAHSValidates, averages and reports the data
